title: Fugl Dam
world: Present-day Norway and the open sea, over fourteen years. The King lives in a big city palace with a green palace park and naps on a leather sofa in his office. The twelve princes sail a large white sailing-and-motor yacht; the eleven older princes wear matching navy sailing jackets, and the eleven older princesses dress in different soft colours. On a small rocky island that is on no chart stands the Glass Castle, walled with tall glass arches between stone pillars. Far across the sea, the Dark Castle on a rocky shore holds the twelve-headed troll's gilded chamber. The little dog on the island is fluffy and white, with floppy brown ears. The crown cupboard is a waist-high blue wooden cupboard with red-and-white rosemaling, holding twelve small gold crowns on dark velvet. The iron boat is small and dark, with no motor, sail or oars.
palette: Steel-grey and petrol-blue open sea, from three-day storms with white spray to sudden glassy calm under silver skies; night scenes in deep navy with warm lamp light. Back home, the crisp gold light of early autumn in the palace park, with yellowing birches and flags in the wind. Accents: Ridder Rød's bright red jacket, the prince's forest green and the gold of the crowns.

cast.name: Den yngste kongssønnen
cast.description: Den yngste av tolv prinser, utholdende og observant, som alene tar sjansen, dreper uhyret, henter kronene og avslører løgnen når makt og frykt prøver å dysse ned sannheten.
cast.look: A slim, brave prince of about twenty-four with a kind, open face, a fine straight nose, calm green-grey eyes, a ready smile and wavy dark-brown hair to his shoulders, a little stiff with salt. He wears a forest-green sailing jacket over a thick off-white Aran sweater, dark-grey trousers and brown deck boots, with a small gold pin shaped like a ship on his collar.
cast.portrait: Background: the deck of the Yacht and a steel-grey sea.

cast.name: Sjømannen
cast.description: Den yngste kongssønnen i forkledning, i en stor, gammel sjømannsfrakk. Han later som han er en skipbrudden matros, og siden kommer han som selger med en kasse på ryggen.
cast.look: A lean young seaman of about twenty-four in disguise, with a kind face, a fine straight nose, calm green-grey eyes and a few days' dark stubble, his wavy dark-brown hair pushed under a sun-bleached red watch cap. He wears a huge old navy sailor's greatcoat with tarnished buttons that hangs to his knees, canvas work trousers and salt-stained rubber boots.
cast.portrait: Background: a small crooked house by the harbour.

cast.name: Den yngste prinsessen
cast.description: Den mest stille av de tolv, merket av fangenskapet og trusselen fra Ridder Rød, men modig nok til å peke ut sannheten når kronene kommer fram.
cast.look: A small, slight young woman of about twenty-two with a round, solemn face, a short nose, deep-blue eyes under thick, level brows and a small, determined mouth. Her honey-brown hair is braided into a crown around her head. She wears a simple long cream-coloured knitted dress with a thin gold belt, and a little silver anchor pendant on a fine chain.
cast.portrait: Background: a tall palace window over the autumn park.

cast.name: Fugl Dam
cast.description: En fugl så stor at den nesten fyller gårdsplassen, med fjær som kabler og bark, som spiser fire tønner rug til frokost og flyr kongssønnen forbi yachten.
cast.look: An enormous bird so big that it nearly fills a castle courtyard, shaped a little like a giant gull, with a pale silver-grey back and wings with black tips, a snowy-white head and breast, kind dark eyes, a huge hooked golden-yellow beak and orange webbed feet. Its feathers look like twisted steel cables and strips of bark, and from the back of its neck rises one enormous, stiff copper-red feather as thick as a half-grown spruce.
cast.portrait: Background: a steel-grey sea under racing clouds.

cast.name: Ridder Rød
cast.description: Styrmannen i den røde seilerjakken, som seiler fra den yngste kongssønnen, tar æren for redningen og sender ut pressemeldingen om forlovelsen selv.
cast.look: A tall, barrel-chested, vain man of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud, camera-ready smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He always wears the same bright red offshore sailing jacket with the collar turned up, over white trousers, navy deck shoes and a heavy gold diver's watch.
cast.portrait: Background: the wheel on the flybridge of the Yacht.

cast.name: Storetrollet med tolv hoder
cast.description: Sjefen til trollet på øya. Han sitter pyntet som til fest i en praktfull sal, med tolv hoder som snorker i tolv forskjellige takter, mens prinsessene luser ham.
cast.look: A huge, hulking troll about three times as tall as a man, with rust-red, warty skin, a broad, sagging barrel of a body, very long arms that hang to the floor and short bowed legs. On his thick neck sits a bunch of exactly twelve small heads, packed tightly together like a bunch of turnips, each with a knobbly nose, droopy ears and a wispy tuft of straw-coloured hair. He is dressed for a party in a dark-blue velvet dinner jacket, heavy gold chains and rings on every finger.
cast.portrait: Background: his gilded chamber in the Dark Castle.

cast.name: Trollet på øya
cast.description: Et stort og stygt troll på en benk i slottet av stein og glass. Han gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken, for han er lei av sjefen sin.
cast.look: A huge, strange troll about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly, short legs and huge webbed feet like a duck's. His skin is a weathered, ruddy tan. He has a nose as long as a cucumber, small unblinking amber eyes, big ears like cabbage leaves and a stiff crest of dark-brown hair standing straight up like a brush. He wears a baggy mulberry-purple knitted jumper and grey work trousers.
cast.portrait: Background: the tall glass arches of the Glass Castle.

cast.name: Trollkongen (øya-slottet)
cast.description: Det store, stygge trollet på benken i slottet av stein og glass, som gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken for å bli kvitt sjefen sin, og som går i dress og krone når han selv blir konge.
cast.look: A huge troll king about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly and huge webbed feet like a duck's, weathered ruddy-tan skin, a nose as long as a cucumber, small amber eyes, ears like cabbage leaves and a brush-like crest of dark-brown hair. He wears an enormous charcoal suit with a mulberry-purple tie, gold chains across his waistcoat, a fur cape on his shoulders and a gold crown.
cast.portrait: Background: the tall glass arches of the Glass Castle.

cast.name: Trolldatteren
cast.description: Trollets datter. Først er hun en liten, våt hund på en øy, så en vakker og alvorlig ung kvinne som sender faren sin lange blikk. I mange år syr hun skjorter og sengetøy til kongssønnen.
cast.look: A willowy young woman of about twenty-two with pale, milky skin, a long, narrow face, a tiny pointed nose, big silvery-grey eyes, a serious, unimpressed look and long, pale-blonde hair that drifts around her as if she were under water. She wears a long apricot-coloured knitted dress and a thin silver bracelet, and goes barefoot.
cast.portrait: Background: the white light of the Glass Castle.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: Prinsessenes far, som helst vil ha de tolv døtrene rundt seg hele tiden, og som slutter å sove middag da de blir borte.
cast.look: A small, wiry, elderly king with a narrow, kind, crinkly face, a small sharp nose, twinkling blue eyes, wisps of silver hair and a long silver-grey beard braided into two plaits tied with little gold rings. He wears a dark navy suit with a turquoise tie and a silver tie pin shaped like a fish, and soft grey felt slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: the leather sofa in his palace office.

cast.name: Den gamle damen
cast.description: En nysgjerrig gammel dame i et skjevt hus ved havnen, som spør og graver og ringer alle hun kjenner med nyheten.
cast.look: A short, bustling old lady with a plump little body on thin legs, like a robin, and a long neck that she cranes forward to see everything. She has a sharp little chin, a beaky nose, big curious eyes magnified by thick, round glasses and wispy white hair scraped into a tiny topknot like an onion. She wears a lavender cardigan over a flowered dress, an orange knitted scarf and a patched brown apron with a mobile phone in its deep pocket.
cast.portrait: Background: her small crooked house by the harbour.

places.name: the Yacht
places.look: A large, sleek white sailing-and-motor yacht with a dark-blue stripe along the hull, one tall mast with white sails, a raised flybridge with a steering wheel, a cockpit with cushioned benches, a low steel rail around the deck, portholes along the side and a grey inflatable dinghy hanging from davits at the stern.

places.name: the Glass Castle
places.look: A big castle on a small rocky island, built of pale grey stone and glass: its walls are almost all windows, tall glass arches between thick stone pillars, so the light inside is sharp and white. Inside is one long hall with a polished stone floor and a long stone bench along the wall; outside, seaweed-covered rocks and smooth grey slabs slope down to the sea.

places.name: the Dark Castle
places.look: A grim castle of dark stone on a rocky shore far across the sea, with heavy square towers, narrow windows glowing gold, and a great arched gate facing the sea. Inside the gate lies a wide paved courtyard with an old grey storehouse on posts in one corner. Dark rocks, seaweed and white surf at its foot.

cover.prompt: Seen from below and behind, the Giant Bird soars over a steel-grey sea with its huge wings spread wide, and the Youngest Prince rides on its back, holding tight to the copper-red neck feather, his hair blowing. The blue crown cupboard hangs from ropes on one side of the bird's neck and a bulging sack of gold and silver on the other. Far below, the Yacht is a small white shape on the waves.
cover.caption: Og så bar det av sted, så det suste.
cover.alt: Den yngste kongssønnen sitter på ryggen til en kjempestor fugl høyt over havet. På den ene siden av halsen henger et skap, på den andre en sekk med gull, og langt der nede seiler yachten.

illustrations.anchor: Det eneste de hadde for seg selv, var middagsluren hans.
illustrations.prompt: After lunch in the King's big wood-panelled office in the palace: the King lies asleep on a leather sofa with his tie loosened and his mouth open. Past the open door, twelve young women tiptoe out towards the green palace park beyond the tall windows: eleven sisters in different soft colours, and last of all the Youngest Princess, glancing back at him with a small smile, one finger to her lips. No bodyguards in sight.
illustrations.caption: Hver dag etter lunsj la kongen seg på sofaen på kontoret og sov i tjue minutter.
illustrations.alt: Kongen sover på sofaen på kontoret sitt. Tolv prinsesser lister seg ut døra mot slottsparken, og den yngste ser seg tilbake og smiler.

illustrations.anchor: Det ble stor sorg i hele landet, men ingen sørget som kongen.
illustrations.prompt: A packed press conference in a bright police briefing room: three police officers in uniform sit behind a long table crowded with microphones, one of them leaning in to speak, while photographers and TV cameras crowd the front. In the front row sits the King, small and crumpled, staring at the floor. On a big screen behind the officers glows only the simple dark silhouette of a steep mountain.
illustrations.caption: Prinsessene var etter alt å dømme bergtatt.
illustrations.alt: På en pressekonferanse sitter tre politifolk bak et bord fullt av mikrofoner, foran fotografer og kameraer. På første rad sitter kongen og stirrer i gulvet.

illustrations.anchor: Han kjøpte en seil- og motoryacht til dem og satte Ridder Rød til styrmann
illustrations.prompt: The Yacht motors out of a busy city harbour on a bright, windy morning. At the rail, the Youngest Prince and his eleven older brothers in matching navy sailing jackets wave to a small crowd on the quay, where their white-haired father raises one hand. On the flybridge, Ridder Rød stands at the wheel in his bright red sailing jacket, chin up, posing as if for a photographer.
illustrations.caption: Ridder Rød gikk aldri i annet enn den røde seilerjakken.
illustrations.alt: En stor seilbåt glir ut av havna. Tolv prinser vinker fra rekka, og oppe ved rattet står Ridder Rød i den røde seilerjakken og ser viktig ut.

illustrations.anchor: Han gikk fram og tilbake på dekk, og da gled de forbi en liten øy.
illustrations.prompt: A pale, glassy calm after the storm. On the deck of the Yacht, several of the older princes lie asleep in a heap in their oilskins, and Ridder Rød snores in the cockpit with his red hood pulled up. Only the Youngest Prince is awake, leaning over the rail and whistling to a small rocky island gliding past, where a small fluffy white dog with floppy brown ears races along the shore, barking and growling at the boat.
illustrations.caption: Øya sto ikke i kartplotteren.
illustrations.alt: Alle om bord sover i oljeklærne, unntatt den yngste kongssønnen. Han lener seg over rekka og plystrer på en liten hvit hund som bjeffer på en øy.

illustrations.anchor: På en benk langs veggen satt en mann så stor og så stygg
illustrations.prompt: Inside the Glass Castle, in sharp white light from the tall glass arches, a small shower of drops still hangs in the air where the wet little dog has just shaken itself, and in its place stands the Troll's Daughter, calm and serious. The Youngest Prince, salt in his hair and his clothes damp with spray, stands frozen. On a long stone bench against the wall sits the Island Troll, huge and ugly, watching them with unblinking eyes.
illustrations.caption: Den ristet seg, slik våte hunder gjør, og ble til en ung kvinne.
illustrations.alt: I et slott av stein og glass har den lille hunden blitt til en ung kvinne. Kongssønnen står stiv av skrekk, og på en benk langs veggen sitter en diger, stygg mann og stirrer.

illustrations.anchor: Det smakte omtrent slik et anker ser ut.
illustrations.prompt: In the Glass Castle, the Youngest Prince swings a long, rusty old sword over his head as easily as a kitchen spatula, grinning in astonishment, with a dark glass bottle at his feet. The Island Troll sits on his stone bench and nods slowly, unblinking. The Troll's Daughter stands by a stone pillar with her arms folded, giving her father a look that says they will talk about this later.
illustrations.caption: Etter tre slurker svingte han det så lett som en stekespade.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen svinger et gammelt, rustent sverd like lett som en stekespade. Trollet på benken nikker, og datteren ser strengt på faren sin.

illustrations.anchor: Kongssønnen rodde tilbake med sverdet og husket hvert ord.
illustrations.prompt: Night below deck in a narrow yacht cabin with four bunks. Three of the older princes sleep in the other bunks, snoring. The Youngest Prince, still in his damp jacket, kneels by his own bunk and quietly slides the long rusty sword under the mattress, glancing over his shoulder, lit only by a small red night light.
illustrations.caption: Han la sverdet under madrassen i køyen sin.
illustrations.alt: Om natta i en trang lugar skyver kongssønnen sverdet inn under madrassen i køya si, mens brødrene sover og snorker.

illustrations.anchor: Vaktene sto der, slik han var blitt lovet: ulver og bjørner og løver.
illustrations.prompt: Blue dusk at the arched gate of the Dark Castle, surf booming on the rocks below. Two grey wolves, two brown bears and three lions have all lain down at the Youngest Prince's feet, heads on their paws. He steps carefully between them with the rusty sword in his hand, staring at the lions in particular, as if he still does not quite believe in them.
illustrations.caption: Løvene hadde han aldri helt trodd på.
illustrations.alt: Utenfor et mørkt slott ligger ulver, bjørner og løver for føttene til kongssønnen. Han går forsiktig mellom dem og ser vantro på løvene.

illustrations.anchor: Kongssønnen vinket til dem at de skulle flytte seg.
illustrations.prompt: A splendid chamber hung with gold, where the Great Troll sits asleep in a huge armchair, dressed up for a party, all twelve heads snoring with their mouths open. Around him stand twelve little golden chairs with lice combs left on the seats, emptying as the princesses rise and tiptoe away: the Youngest Princess, the first to understand, leads her eleven sisters towards the Youngest Prince, who waits by the door with the rusty sword, beckoning.
illustrations.caption: Til slutt skjønte de, den yngste først, at han var kommet for å berge dem.
illustrations.alt: Et rustrødt troll med tolv hoder sover i en stor stol, pyntet som til fest. Tolv prinsesser lister seg bort fra gullstolene mot kongssønnen, som står ved døra med sverdet.

illustrations.anchor: Alle var glade nå, men ingen var gladere enn prinsessene
illustrations.prompt: A bright, windy morning at a rocky shore, where the Yacht lies moored against the rocks. A chain of laughing princes and princesses passes chests of gold and silver along a gangway onto the deck. The Youngest Prince hands a heavy silver jug up to the Youngest Princess, and they smile at each other, while eleven more princesses and eleven princes in navy sailing jackets bustle about with treasure.
illustrations.caption: Ingen var gladere enn prinsessene, som slapp å luse et troll dagen lang.
illustrations.alt: Prinser og prinsesser ler og sender gull og sølv om bord på yachten. Den yngste kongssønnen rekker ei sølvkanne opp til den yngste prinsessen.

illustrations.anchor: «Det er ingen vits i å ligge her og vente», sa han.
illustrations.prompt: On the deck of the Yacht, lying still with its sails lowered, Ridder Rød stands in the cockpit in his red jacket, one finger jabbing the air, laying down the law. The eleven older princes huddle in front of him with bowed heads, not daring to answer. Behind them the Youngest Princess grips the rail and stares back at the empty sea where the dinghy has vanished, while her eleven sisters cling to each other.
illustrations.caption: «Når vi kommer hjem, sier dere at det var jeg som berget prinsessene.»
illustrations.alt: Ridder Rød står i cockpiten i den røde jakken og kommanderer, og de elleve prinsene bøyer hodet. Den yngste prinsessen holder seg i rekka og ser utover det tomme havet.

illustrations.anchor: Imens rodde den yngste i land, gikk opp i slottet og fant skapet med gullkronene.
illustrations.prompt: Late afternoon on a grey sea off a rocky shore, the Dark Castle small and dark on the rocks behind. The Youngest Prince sits in the grey inflatable dinghy, riding low under the heavy blue crown cupboard wedged in beside him. He has stopped rowing and stares this way and that, one hand shading his eyes. All around, the sea is empty to the horizon: no yacht, no sail, nothing.
illustrations.caption: Han så seg rundt til alle kanter. Havet var tomt.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen sitter i en gummibåt med et tungt skap og ser seg rundt. Yachten er borte, og havet er tomt så langt øyet rekker.

illustrations.anchor: Stabburet sto i et hjørne av gårdsplassen, på stolper, gammelt og grått.
illustrations.prompt: Morning in the courtyard of the Dark Castle, littered with huge feathers, crushed stone and broken glass. The Giant Bird nearly fills the whole courtyard, bending its enormous beak down to swallow the rye from three emptied barrels. The Youngest Prince, tiny beside its orange feet, drags the fourth and last heavy barrel over from an old grey storehouse on posts in the corner, sweating, looking far up at the bird.
illustrations.caption: Da han kom slitende med den fjerde tønnen, slukte Fugl Dam kornet uten å blunke.
illustrations.alt: På gårdsplassen står en fugl som nesten fyller hele plassen, med fjær som ligner kabler og bark. Kongssønnen sleper den fjerde tønnen med rug fram fra stabburet.

illustrations.anchor: Langt om lenge kom de fram til trollet.
illustrations.prompt: In the bright hall of the Glass Castle, the Troll King, now in his huge suit, tie, gold chains, fur cape and crown, throws his arms wide to welcome the Youngest Prince, beaming. Beside him the Troll's Daughter gives her father the same look as before, arms folded. Through the tall glass arches, the Giant Bird can be seen resting on the rocks outside, preening its neck feather.
illustrations.caption: Han var konge nå, og det syntes.
illustrations.alt: Trollet, nå i dress, pelskappe og krone, tar imot kongssønnen med åpne armer. Datteren står med armene i kors, og utenfor glassveggen hviler Fugl Dam.

illustrations.anchor: På gulvet foran sengen lå Ridder Rød i den røde jakken
illustrations.prompt: Night in the last cabin of the yacht, lit by a dim reading lamp. The Youngest Princess lies asleep alone, pale and still, with an unsheathed rusty sword laid in front of her on the duvet. On the carpet before the bed, Ridder Rød lies slumped in his red jacket, cheek against the floor, asleep. In the doorway the Youngest Prince stands silently looking at her, one hand on the doorframe.
illustrations.caption: Lenger enn til gulvet var han ikke kommet.
illustrations.alt: I lugaren sover den yngste prinsessen alene med et sverd foran seg i sengen. På gulvet ligger Ridder Rød og sover i den røde jakken, og kongssønnen står stille i døra.

illustrations.anchor: Da han reiste, fikk han med seg så mye gull og sølv og andre fine ting
illustrations.prompt: Dawn on the rocky shore below the Glass Castle. A small dark iron boat with no motor, no sail and no oars waits at the water's edge with a heavy iron club lying in it. The Youngest Prince loads it with sacks of gold and silver, while the Troll King in his suit, cape and crown waves a big hand, and the Troll's Daughter hands over a tall pile of neatly folded shirts and bedlinen she has sewn for him.
illustrations.caption: Jernbåten hadde verken motor, seil eller årer. Den trengte ingen av delene.
illustrations.alt: Ved stranda ligger en liten jernbåt uten motor, seil eller årer. Kongssønnen laster inn gull og sølv, trollkongen vinker, og datteren gir ham en stabel med skjorter og sengetøy.

illustrations.anchor: Han hadde knapt satt seg i båten og sagt «Båt, gå fram!» før den gikk.
illustrations.prompt: On a wild grey sea, the small dark iron boat speeds along by itself, and the Youngest Prince sets the heavy iron club down in it as carefully as a full cup of coffee. Close beside him the Yacht heels over in a sudden storm, white foam all round its hull and waves breaking over the deck, while tiny figures in oilskins haul on ropes, far too busy to notice the boat gliding past.
illustrations.caption: Han la klubben ned igjen like forsiktig som man setter fra seg en full kaffekopp.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen suser forbi i en liten jernbåt og legger jernklubben varsomt ned. Ved siden av krenger yachten i stormen, og alle om bord har nok med seg selv.

illustrations.anchor: Om kvelden bar han inn sakene sine
illustrations.prompt: Inside a small, crooked house by the harbour, crammed with knick-knacks, with one armchair and a rattling window. The Sailor sits squeezed onto a kitchen stool among his crates and bundles, holding his head in both hands as if it aches. The Nosy Old Lady leans in so close that her glasses almost touch his nose, one finger raised, firing questions at him while peering sideways at his crates.
illustrations.caption: Hvem var han? Hvor kom han fra? Hva hadde han i alle de kassene?
illustrations.alt: I et lite, skjevt hus ved havnen lener en nysgjerrig gammel dame seg helt inn til sjømannen og spør og spør. Han sitter blant kassene sine og holder seg for hodet.

illustrations.anchor: Dagen etter begynte damen å spørre og grave igjen.
illustrations.prompt: A tiny crooked house by the harbour, now packed: five more old ladies of different shapes and sizes, in raincoats and headscarves, have squeezed in, each holding a cake tin or a plate of waffles and leaning towards the Sailor with eager faces. He sits in the corner holding his aching head. The Nosy Old Lady stands proudly in the middle with her mobile phone in her hand.
illustrations.caption: Snart kom de, den ene etter den andre, med kake som påskudd.
illustrations.alt: Det lille huset er fullt av gamle damer med kakeformer og vaffelfat som vil vite mer. Sjømannen sitter i hjørnet og holder seg for hodet.

illustrations.anchor: «Ja, det har jeg», sa sjømannen.
illustrations.prompt: In a grand, high-ceilinged palace drawing room with tall windows onto the park, the Sailor in his huge old greatcoat stands on the thick carpet, shabby and salt-stained. Before him the King, who has grown old and grey, leans forward from a gilded armchair, gripping its arms, his crinkly face suddenly full of hope. Two courtiers in dark suits and a chauffeur in a cap wait by the door.
illustrations.caption: «Lever de, er de her om en fjorten dagers tid, kanskje før.»
illustrations.alt: Sjømannen står i den store frakken sin foran kongen i en fin sal på slottet. Kongen lener seg fram i stolen og ser plutselig håpefull ut.

illustrations.anchor: De elleve eldste prinsessene var glade og lystige de også.
illustrations.prompt: A crowded quay in bright sunshine: the Yacht has just tied up, a brass band plays, flags wave, and photographers and TV cameras jostle behind a barrier. The King, in full regalia with a low gold crown and a long turquoise cape, hugs his laughing daughters as they come ashore. A little apart, the Youngest Princess stands weeping, and Ridder Rød, in his red jacket, keeps a firm arm round her shoulders and smiles broadly for the cameras.
illustrations.caption: Forlovelsen var kunngjort før yachten la til kai.
illustrations.alt: På en kai full av folk, musikk og kameraer klemmer kongen døtrene sine. Den yngste prinsessen gråter, og Ridder Rød holder rundt henne og smiler til fotografene.

illustrations.anchor: Så begynte forberedelsene.
illustrations.prompt: In a bright palace fitting room, the Youngest Princess and her eleven sisters stand on low stools in half-finished white wedding dresses while four seamstresses with pins in their mouths bustle round them. In the doorway stands the Sailor in his huge old greatcoat, a worn wooden crate full of gold and silver trinkets on his back, offering his wares. The Youngest Princess turns on her stool and looks at him hard, as if she knows him from somewhere.
illustrations.caption: De så på varene, og de så på ham.
illustrations.alt: Tolv prinsesser står på skamler i halvferdige brudekjoler, og syerskene har knappenåler i munnen. I døra står sjømannen med en kasse varer på ryggen, og den yngste prinsessen ser granskende på ham.

illustrations.anchor: Hun pekte på Ridder Rød, forbi kronene.
illustrations.prompt: The palace great hall, decorated for the wedding with flowers in tall urns, floodlights and TV cameras on tripods. In the middle of the floor stands the open blue crown cupboard, twelve small gold crowns glowing on dark velvet. The Youngest Princess points straight past the crowns at Ridder Rød in his red jacket, whose big smile is collapsing like a sail when the wind dies. Beside the cupboard waits the Sailor, and the King stares from his chair.
illustrations.caption: Smilet falt sammen, litt etter litt, som et seil når vinden løyer.
illustrations.alt: I den pyntede salen står skapet åpent med tolv gullkroner på mørk fløyel. Den yngste prinsessen peker på Ridder Rød, og smilet hans faller sammen.

illustrations.anchor: Først nå ble det skikkelig glede på slottet.
illustrations.prompt: A huge wedding party in the palace great hall, full of flowers and warm light. Twelve bridal couples dance at once: in the middle, the Youngest Prince, in a fine dark-green suit, whirls the Youngest Princess round, and around them the eleven older princes dance with the eleven older princesses, every princess wearing her gold crown. The King, in his crown, claps along, beaming, while a small band plays.
illustrations.caption: Den yngste valgte den yngste kongssønnen. Det tok henne ikke lang tid.
illustrations.alt: Tolv brudepar danser i den store salen. I midten danser den yngste kongssønnen og den yngste prinsessen, og kongen klapper i takt.
